notes.note: navigation-store.ts gained a same-URL index assignment in handlePopState, two read-only getters (traversalAwaitsGuard, traversalDepartedIndex), an exported navigationEntryIndex, and navigate() no longer copies main's page stamp to a new entry. The document's claims about this file are that it is the navigation authority and that URL/popstate/back-forward remain authoritative over persisted host selection; both still hold — the change adds history entries for main's page swap and does not move authority.
